module: Node "Stored AI Path" (provider, color ai). Stores in the project a ScriptAI path recorded with the ScriptAIManager editor and provides it. Output: path (type aiPath) = {path = aiPath}. The inspector allows opening ScriptAIManager, choosing a current recording and loading it into the node; the path is drawn in debug (magenta prisms).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes an empty path and the identifier "Select...".

drawDebugPath.desc: Draws the stored path with debugDrawer:drawSquarePrism for the points close to the camera (100 to 200 m).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Displays the number of elements, the debug path, the button to open ScriptAIManager, the recording selector and the load button.

work.desc: Publishes {path = self.aiPath} on the path output.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the number of elements of the path.
